title: Continue to handle notifications even when Notifications tray icon is disabled
line: Notifications keep working without a Notifications widget, for example with the System Tray entry turned off, and a new option hands them to another notification server.
explanation: The notification server and the popups lived in the Notifications widget's shared state, so they only existed while a Notifications widget was loaded. Turning off the System Tray's Notifications entry, removing the tray or using a layout without one left org.freedesktop.Notifications without an owner and every notification was lost; turning the entry off at runtime even left popups stranded in the top-left corner until a restart. The popups, Do Not Disturb, global shortcuts and the shared delegates now live in a module, org.kde.plasma.private.notifications, that plasmashell creates at startup, so the widget only shows history and settings and still decides placement when present. Whether Plasma handles notifications is now an explicit setting of the notifications stack (UsePlasmaNotifications, a "Use Plasma" checkbox in the Notifications settings): libnotificationmanager watches it and takes or releases org.freedesktop.Notifications and the notification portal live.

+/*

+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include <cstdlib>
+#include <iostream>
+
+#include <KConfigGroup>
+#include <KSharedConfig>
+
+using namespace Qt::StringLiterals;
+
+/**
+ * Notifications used to be handled only while a Notifications widget existed, so turning off
+ * the Notifications entry of the System Tray was how users handed them to another notification
+ * server. plasmashell now always handles them unless "UsePlasmaNotifications" is off, so turn
+ * it off for those users.
+ *
+ * @since 6.9
+ */
+int main()
+{
+    const QString notifications = u"org.kde.plasma.notifications"_s;
+    const KSharedConfigPtr appletsConfig = KSharedConfig::openConfig(u"plasma-org.kde.plasma.desktop-appletsrc"_s, KConfig::SimpleConfig);
+    const KConfigGroup containments(appletsConfig, u"Containments"_s);
+
+    bool turnedOffInSystemTray = false;
+    // A System Tray keeps its entries in its applet's group, or in its own containment's group
+    // in configs from before Plasma 6.4. Returns whether it shows notifications.
+    const auto trayShowsNotifications = [&notifications, &turnedOffInSystemTray](const KConfigGroup &tray) {
+        const KConfigGroup general = tray.group(u"General"_s);
+        if (general.readEntry("extraItems", QStringList()).contains(notifications)) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        if (general.readEntry("knownItems", QStringList()).contains(notifications)) {
+            turnedOffInSystemTray = true;
+        }
+        return false;
+    };
+
+    const QStringList containmentIds = containments.groupList();
+    for (const QString &containmentId : containmentIds) {
+        const KConfigGroup containment = containments.group(containmentId);
+        if (trayShowsNotifications(containment)) {
+            std::cout << "A System Tray shows notifications. No need to update config." << std::endl;
+            return EXIT_SUCCESS;
+        }
+
+        const KConfigGroup applets = containment.group(u"Applets"_s);
+        const QStringList appletIds = applets.groupList();
+        for (const QString &appletId : appletIds) {
+            const KConfigGroup applet = applets.group(appletId);
+            if (applet.readEntry("plugin", QString()) == notifications) {
+                std::cout << "There is a Notifications widget. No need to update config." << std::endl;
+                return EXIT_SUCCESS;
+            }
+            if (trayShowsNotifications(applet)) {
+                std::cout << "A System Tray shows notifications. No need to update config." << std::endl;
+                return EXIT_SUCCESS;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (!turnedOffInSystemTray) {
+        std::cout << "Notifications were not turned off in a System Tray. No need to update config." << std::endl;
+        return EXIT_SUCCESS;
+    }
+
+    const KSharedConfigPtr notifyConfig = KSharedConfig::openConfig(u"plasmanotifyrc"_s, KConfig::SimpleConfig);
+    KConfigGroup(notifyConfig, u"Notifications"_s).writeEntry("UsePlasmaNotifications", false);
+
+    return notifyConfig->sync() ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
+}

+    // which only shows their history. Only Plasma Desktop uses it, other shells have their own.
+    if (m_notifications || m_shell != u"org.kde.plasma.desktop") {

+    }
+
+    m_notifications = PlasmaQuick::globalEngine()->singletonInstance<QObject *>("org.kde.plasma.private.notifications", "Globals");

+void ShellCorona::updateNotificationsContainment()
+{
+    // Without a Notifications widget to follow, popups follow a panel on the primary screen,
+    // preferring the bottom, top, right and then left one, or else its desktop
+    const auto score = [](Plasma::Types::Location location) {
+        switch (location) {
+        case Plasma::Types::BottomEdge:
+            return 4;
+        case Plasma::Types::TopEdge:
+            return 3;
+        case Plasma::Types::RightEdge:
+            return 2;
+        case Plasma::Types::LeftEdge:
+            return 1;
+        default:
+            return 0;
+        }
+    };
+
+    Plasma::Containment *containment = nullptr;
+    const auto containments = this->containments();
+    for (Plasma::Containment *candidate : containments) {
+        if (candidate->containmentType() != Plasma::Containment::Panel || candidate->screen() != 0 || candidate->destroyed()) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if (!containment || score(candidate->location()) > score(containment->location())) {
+            containment = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (!containment) {
+        containment = containmentForScreen(0, m_activityController->currentActivity(), QString());
+    }
+    if (containment) {
+        const auto connection = static_cast<Qt::ConnectionType>(Qt::QueuedConnection | Qt::UniqueConnection);
+        connect(containment, &Plasma::Applet::destroyedChanged, this, &ShellCorona::updateNotificationsContainment, connection);
+        connect(containment, &QObject::destroyed, this, &ShellCorona::updateNotificationsContainment, connection);
+    }
+
+    m_notifications->setProperty("fallbackContainment", QVariant::fromValue<QObject *>(containment));
